digest.component_or_area: inbound reconciler: parent field diffing and snapshot enrichment
propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never propagated as a local parent_id clear because the fetcher omits absent parents from snapshots and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None
The snapshots must carry explicit None for observed-absent parents to distinguish 'queried and no parent' from 'never queried or read failed'
The differ must gate parent clears on positive peer evidence (last-synced parent state from binding store) to prevent clearing locally-managed parents the peer never actually had
The same-pass suppression via _OUTBOUND_TO_INBOUND_FIELD blocks inbound clears when outbound writes parent in the same pass, protecting against local overwrites during healthy degradation windows
